title: 第2335章 你想要什么交代第2334章 栽赃嫁祸
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 秦叶瞥了他们一眼，目光平静如水。
对于栽赃嫁祸的手段，他再熟悉不过了。
这世上任何人都要脸，不会无缘无故的就动手，尤其是在外人面前。
所以为了动手的合法性，都要占据大义。
哪怕是他，也会抢先占一个道德高峰，因为这一招太好用了。
只是今天倒过来了，反而是让纵横城占据了道德高峰。
不过，他也无所谓。
他缓缓地开口，声音并不是太大，却清晰地传入了在场每一个人的耳中。
“你们说那么多，不就是要动手吗？”
秦叶的目光落在周林的身上，嘴角依然带着一丝淡淡的笑意。
秦叶的话一出，周林的脸色顿时变的很难看。
他没有想到这个毛头小子，说话居然如此直白，连狡辩一下都不狡辩，直接就把窗户纸给捅破了。
但是，周林乃是老江湖了，反应非常快。
“放肆！”
周林厉声高喝道：“怎么，你是想说是我们诬陷你吗？你说哪一点我们诬陷你了。”
“你没有杀我们少主吗？”
“还是你是南域的人？”
“你若是清白的，不如自缚，乖乖跟老夫回纵横城，自证清白，我们纵横城绝对不会冤枉你。”
“自证清白？”
秦叶轻笑一声，往前走了一步。
然而，就这么轻轻走了一步，周林以及纵横城城主身后一些强者竟不自觉地后退了半步。
可见，他们对秦叶的实力还是有清楚认识的。
秦叶将这一幕看在眼里，嘴角的笑意更浓了。
“跟你们去了纵横城，别说自证清白了，只怕早就被你们挫骨扬灰了。”
秦叶淡笑一声，说道。
“纵横城光明磊落，岂会做出出尔反尔之事，你休要诬蔑。”
周林冷声道。
秦叶没有反驳，只是轻轻一笑，说道：“你们兴师动众而来，不就是要来杀我吗？”
“现在我给你们机会，你们是一个个上，还是一起上。”
秦叶的目光扫向周林以及纵横城一众强者。
周围顿时一片寂静。
纵横城将秦叶包围在这里，肯定是要动手的。
现在秦叶狂妄的要挑战整个纵横城，这在不少人看来，这简直是在找死。
周林的脸色变得极为难看，他张了张嘴，一时之间竟找不到合适的话。
让他动手，他也没有这个胆子。
“既然没有人动手，那我就走了。”
content_en:
Qin Ye glanced at them, his eyes as calm as water.
He is all too familiar with the method of framing someone.
Everyone in this world has a face and will not do anything without any reason, especially in front of outsiders.
Therefore, in order to have the legality of taking action, we must occupy the great righteousness.
Even he will seize a moral peak first, because this trick is so easy to use.
It's just that today it's the other way around, allowing Zongheng City to occupy the moral peak.
However, it doesn't matter to him.
He spoke slowly, his voice not too loud, but it reached the ears of everyone present clearly.
"You say so much, don't you just want to take action?"
Qin Ye's eyes fell on Zhou Lin, with a faint smile still on his lips.
As soon as Qin Ye's words came out, Zhou Lin's face suddenly turned ugly.
He didn't expect that this young boy could speak so straightforwardly. He didn't even quibble a bit and just pierced the window paper.
However, Zhou Lin is an old man and reacts very quickly.
"Presumptuous!"
Zhou Lin shouted sternly: "What, do you want to say that we framed you? What point did you say we framed you?"
"Didn't you kill our young master?"
"Or are you from the Southern Territory?"
"If you are innocent, you might as well tie yourself up and follow me back to Zongheng City to prove your innocence. We in Zongheng City will never wrongly accuse you."
"Self-proven innocence?"
Qin Ye chuckled and took a step forward.
However, after taking just one step, Zhou Lin and some strong men behind Zongheng City Lord unconsciously took half a step back.
It can be seen that they still have a clear understanding of Qin Ye's strength.
Qin Ye saw this scene in his eyes, and the smile on his lips became thicker.
"I went to Zongheng City with you. Not to mention proving my innocence, I'm afraid I would have been crushed by you long ago."
Qin Ye smiled lightly and said.
"Zonghengcheng is an upright person. How could he do anything contrary to his promise? Don't slander me."
Zhou Lin said coldly.
Qin Ye didn't refute, just smiled softly and said, "Aren't you just coming here to kill me?"
"Now I'll give you a chance. Do you want to do it one by one or together?"
Qin Ye glanced at Zhou Lin and the powerful men in Zongheng City.
There was silence all around.
Zongheng City surrounded Qin Ye here and would definitely take action.
Now Qin Ye arrogantly wants to challenge the entire Zongheng City. In the eyes of many people, this is simply asking for death.
Zhou Lin's face became extremely ugly. He opened his mouth, but couldn't find the right words for a moment.
Even if he were to take action, he wouldn't have the guts.
"Since no one takes action, I'll leave."
title_en: Chapter 2335: What explanation do you want? Chapter 2334: Framing the blame
